Date: 04/20/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 395 as introduced would increase the annual obligations of state and local law enforcement agencies, by an undetermined amount, for mental health assessments conducted by board-certified psychiatrists or licensed psychologists, of every law enforcement officer employed or hired by a state or local enforcement agency once every five years beginning on January 1, 2022.
Tom Whatley, Chairperson
Judiciary
